title: Deploy: first-run experience
description:
Improve kithd startup for first-time users: auto-detect owner identity from Tailscale Status if not configured, add early Tailscale availability check, detect first run and log welcome message, log 'kithd ready at https://...' after binding.

What: Transform opaque daemon startup into a clear, guided first-boot experience.

Algorithm (changes to crates/kithd/src/main.rs):
1. Move LocalApiClient construction BEFORE owner_id validation (currently at step 8, must move to step 3):
   let ts = Arc::new(LocalApiClient::new(&config.ts_socket));
2. Add early Tailscale availability check (new step after ts creation):
   let status = ts.status().await (using a helper or direct call);
   - If fails: log error with remediation message:
     'kithd: Tailscale is not available at {socket}. Is tailscaled running? (sudo systemctl status tailscaled). Will attempt fallback if KITHD_BIND_ADDR is set.'
   - Store status for reuse (avoid calling status() twice)
3. Auto-detect owner_id if KITHD_OWNER_ID not set:
   - If config.owner_id is None AND status succeeded: use status.self_user_id (the node's own Tailscale user ID)
     - Log: info!('auto-detected owner identity from Tailscale: {}', owner_id)
   - If config.owner_id is None AND status failed: exit(1) with:
     'KITHD_OWNER_ID is not set and Tailscale is unavailable. Set KITHD_OWNER_ID to your Tailscale user ID (tailscale status --json | jq .Self.UserID)'
   - If config.owner_id is Some: keep existing value (no validation against status needed for MVP)
4. After DB open: detect first run
   - Query: SELECT value FROM state_counters WHERE type='message' — if returns 0 AND contacts table has 0 rows: this is first run
   - Add pub fn is_first_run(&self) -> Result<bool, KithError> to Store
   - If first run: log at info level:
     'Kith mailbox initialized. To start chatting, add yourself as a contact in the web UI.'
5. After binding tailnet listeners: log actual bound addresses:
   for each bound addr: info!('kithd ready at https://{}/', addr)
   - This gives the user the URL to open in their browser

Defensive programming rules:
- Store the Result<StatusResponse> from step 2 in a variable; do not call status() again in step 3 (avoid double round-trip to tailscaled)
- Auto-detected owner_id must be trimmed and non-empty; if status returns empty UserID, fall back to requiring explicit env var
- Never log the owner_id as a 'secret' — it is a Tailscale user identity string, not a credential
- is_first_run() must not fail silently; propagate errors with ?
- Log messages must use tracing::info! (not eprintln!) so they appear in systemd journal in JSON format
- Do not change the behavior when KITHD_OWNER_ID IS explicitly set — backward-compatible

StatusResponse shape (from kith-tslocal): check crates/kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs for exact field name of self user ID; use the same field already used in auth.rs

Tests (in crates/kithd/tests/):
- Test: if KITHD_OWNER_ID is unset and mock Status returns a valid UserID, the daemon starts with auto-detected ID (oracle: hardcoded test UserID from mock)
- Test: if KITHD_OWNER_ID is unset and Status fails, startup returns error/exits (oracle: error path reached)
- Test: is_first_run() returns true on fresh empty store, false after inserting a contact (oracle: independent DB state)
